newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to slip to 101.90 head of move up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to slip to 101.90 head of move up.

text.p: The June Bund contract on LIFFE faces a period of choppy trade early on Wednesday and will likely pull back towards support at 101.90, technical analysts said.
There is the potential for a base to form around those levels ahead of A move back up, they added.
By 0706 GMT, the June Bund was up one basis point at 102.13 after opening down 0.02 at 102.10.
"Near term, I'm looking for a pullback to the 101.90 area," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM Yieldwatch.
"But we really need to see the market get back through yesterday's high (at 102.36) to confirm that we will push higher with a base in place down at that support area," said Wilkin.
He said there was some evidence of a top forming, but added further signs were needed to confirm this.

"We've got a lot of figures out today and tomorrow," said Wilkin. "If we do get through 102.36 we should push higher to target 102.49, then the 102.61 area where there are a few Fibonacci projections ."
On the downside, a move below 101.88/90 would see a short-term correction down towards the low 101s, Wilkin said.

Carol Harmer, technical analyst at Kempton's Technical Analysis service on the LIFFE floor, said the market was still penned in by resistance from 102.32/39 which had held the market in check on Tuesday.
She said declines were likely in Wednesday's session.
"An opening below 102.17 sends a signal that a short-term top has been attained leaving the contract vulnerable to downside moves with 101.90/87 the first attraction."
She advised covering shorts to here and re-establishing shorts below 101.87 for further weakness to 101.79/70.
By 0724 GMT, September Euromarks were unchanged at 96.75.
